text:
Jordan: I’m handing off for tonight, leaving the quantize-v2 rolling deploy in progress. quick notes below — ping me if anything spikes before 02:00 UTC. :wave:
Priya: thanks — can you confirm the freeze window and rollback triggers?
Jordan: freeze window 22:00-02:00 UTC (no config changes except rollback). Canary plan: 1% -> 5% after 15m -> 20% after another 30m if healthy.
Sam: who’s watching the canary at 5%->20% step? I can keep an eye first hour.
Marta: I’ll be on standby for logs/alerts, +1 for first hour.
Jordan: rollback triggers:
- model latency p50 jumps >50% above baseline for 5m
- error rate (inference 5xx or model errors) >3% over 5m
- GPU OOMs or memory >92% on any node
- prefix validation failing for >1% of requests
If any trigger, roll back to quantize-v1 and notify channel.
Priya: where are the dashboards and the rollback command?
Jordan: Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/Inference/quantize-deploy (watch p50/p95, qps, error-rate)
Sentry: https://sentry.redwood/internal/issue/inf-deploy (errors prefixed with "quantize-v2")
Roll back (k8s job):
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-server model-server=redwood/model:quantize-v1 && kubectl rollout status deploy/model-server -n inference
```
Jordan: smoke tests (run after canary steps):
- ping internal smoke endpoint: `curl -s -X POST https://smoke.redwood/api/run -d '{"suite":"quantize-basic"}'`
- quick embedding sanity: 5 requests sample corpus, check cosine similarity distribution in logs
infra-bot: Canaries scheduled: 2026-03-18T21:45:00Z (1%), 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z (+5%), 2026-03-18T22:30:00Z (+20%)
deploy-bot: Started canary at 1% (deployment id: dpl-20260318-qv2-001). Watching rollout events.
Sam: I’ll run the first smoke tests at +20m and report p50/p95.
Marta: I’ll tail logs for `model-server` pods: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-server -f --tail=200`
Priya: ops checklist copied to runbook: https://playbooks.redwood/internal/quantize-v2-handoff. Notes on expected diff: token latency p95 might increase ~3-8ms on small inputs, throughput should be ~same.
Jordan: FYI — we turned on lightweight KV-caching for embeddings in this deploy which may change cache-hit metrics; if overall token cost spikes >7% relative to baseline, consider rollback.
Sam: if I see p95 increase but error rate stable, do we prefer to continue vs rollback?
Jordan: small p95 drift (<=10ms) is acceptable during canary ramp. If it's sustained across 20% for 15m and user-facing errors are up, rollback.
Marta: tagging @support to prep customer comms if we need rollback? (will do)
Priya: any DB or migration impact?
Jordan: none — purely inference binary + kernel selection changes. No schema or config changes during freeze.
Sam: logging where to post quick signal? I’ll post short readout here with metrics snapshot like: `p50=12ms p95=34ms errors=0.2% gpu=68%`
Jordan: perfect. also watch autoscaler events: `kubectl get hpa -n inference` and the GPU cluster GPU-util panel — sometimes scaling delays mask issues.
infra-bot: Alert rule subscriptions: oncall-eng (channel eng-oncall), infra-pager, oncall-sre. Escalation policy active.
deploy-bot: Canary 5% started — dpl-20260318-qv2-002. Rollout state: progressing.
Marta: saw one transient 502 at +6m, retrying request succeeded. not alarming yet.
Sam: smoke tests completed at +22m: p50=11ms p95=38ms errors=0.3% gpu=72% — looks within expected.
Jordan: thanks team — I’m offline now. Priya/Sam/Marta, you’re the watchers for the next 2h. If anything meets rollback criteria, Sam to execute rollback and Marta to notify support.
Priya: acknowledged. I’ll update the runbook with any anomalies. :memo:
Marta: acknowledged, will keep tailing and post any logs with timestamps.
deploy-bot: Rollout reached 20% and is stable for 10m. Monitoring continues.
Sam: quick question — where to escalate if we see customer-facing latency on hosted tier?
Jordan: page oncall-sre first, then PM-leads and support-svc. Use incident template: https://playbooks.redwood/internal/incident-template.
Priya: thanks, good handoff. signing out in 10. :lock:
Jordan: thanks all, good luck. :thumbsup:
